access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5 Nano release whose API page identifies gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-5-nano alias; OpenAI's deprecation page lists that snapshot for shutdown on 2026-12-11 with gpt-5.6-luna as the recommended replacement. ChatGPT, the GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, and later GPT-5.x releases, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
Two managed serving paths: the first-party developer API and Azure Foundry, whose reasoning-models page names gpt-5-nano with dated feature support
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
The only documented snapshot is already scheduled for shutdown on 2026-12-11, with migration directed at gpt-5.6-luna
